notes: IBM's CICS asynchronous API credit-card example: CSSTATUS (the customer-status service SEQPNT LINKs to, transaction SCCA). GET CONTAINER(INPUTCONTAINER); LINK GETPOL and LINK GETSPND (no COMMAREA, no channel: each DELAYs and RETURNs, run in the same task -- "programs"); '0001' is 'VERY VIP', any other 'REGULAR '; PUT CONTAINER(GETVIPSTATUS); RETURN. Its LINKAGE SECTION is empty: no COMMAREA ("commarea": null). The task starts with the channel its caller passes (#4270, oracle_assumptions.md X24): MYCHANNEL holding INPUTCONTAINER, the 4-byte account number ASYNCPNT / SEQPNT PUT there (no DATATYPE: BIT). The containers the task leaves on MYCHANNEL are compared at its end, as the caller sees them after FETCH CHILD / its LINK. Derived from github.com/cicsdev/cics-async-api-credit-card-application-example (Apache-2.0; Copyright IBM Corp. 2016): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: account-0001
scenarios.why: '0001': LINK GETPOL, LINK GETSPND (each RETURNs), 'VERY VIP' into GETVIPSTATUS

scenarios.name: no-channel
scenarios.why: no channel: GET CONTAINER without CHANNEL has no current channel -- INVREQ RESP2 4 (caught by RESP), ACCOUNT-NUMBER-IN keeps its initial value (no VALUE clause: oracle_assumptions.md L3) so the ELSE branch runs; PUT CONTAINER is INVREQ RESP2 4 too, then RETURN; there is no channel, so nothing more to compare

scenarios.name: delay-invreq
scenarios.why: first scenario's input, but the DELAY fails INVREQ (X72) with no RESP / HANDLE: the default action, an AEIP abend (#5862)

scenarios.name: delay-invreq-2
scenarios.why: as delay-invreq, but the second DELAY of the task (GETSPND, after GETPOL's) fails INVREQ, unhandled: AEIP abend (#5862)
